verdict.rationale: Viam documents broad programmatic coverage of what the app does. The fleet API creates and manages organizations, locations, machines, permissions and fragments. The CLI can call any API method a machine serves (JSON in, JSON out) and can export, query, delete and tag data. Docs say an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person can, and community reports note the whole system is built on gRPC with multiple SDKs. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement; API evidence for UI-centric features such as dataset annotation, ML training and inline-module editing; independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
